    Theme Mode

    📅
    Personalized Workout Schedule
    Set your Day 1 – Day 7 rotation
    ▼

    Define your rolling workout order — Day 1 through Day 7 — up to 3 classes per day, or mark a day as Rest. Your order repeats continuously. If you miss a check-in, GymBro tracks where you left off and reminds you which day you missed.

    ⏱
    Default Break Timer
    Auto-start break duration in Live Mode
    ▼
    Auto-start Break Timer
    When Live Mode is active, automatically start the break timer after each saved set.
    Default Break Duration
    Set an exact default break time (minutes & seconds). Leave at 0:00 to keep it manual.
    🔔
    Notification Alerts
    Sound & vibration when your break timer ends
    ▼
    🔊 Sound Notification
    Play an alert sound when your break timer ends.

    Pick the sound that plays when your break timer ends.

    📳 Vibration Alert
    Vibrate the device when your break timer ends. Works on Android; iOS Safari doesn't yet support device vibration.

    Pick how strong the vibration feels. Tap "Test" to feel it on your device.

    📱 Phone locked or in your pocket? Browsers only allow direct vibration while the screen is on and GymBro is in front of you. Allow notifications below so a lock-screen alert — which vibrates using your phone's own settings — still gets through when the screen is off.
    😴
    Default Rest Days
    Auto-mark weekdays as Rest instead of Absent
    ▼

    On Attendance History, a day with no check-in shows as Absent. Pick up to 2 weekly default rest weekdays and those days will show as Rest Day automatically instead — you can still change any individual day manually on the History page.

    Rest Day Count
    How many default rest days per week (max 2).
    Rest Day 1
    First weekly default rest day.
    Rest Day 2
    Second weekly default rest day.
